coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: 25B

notes.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE -- idealized rectangle (owner-directed, not a hand trace of the lot's own painted edges) anchored on real street-corner intersections and the real, already-tracked Mission Hall footprint. The lot itself is real (visible painted parking stalls in Esri satellite imagery); the exact boundary is idealized to a clean rectangle rather than traced to the pavement's own edges.
notes.digitized_from: Real-gap-fragment technique: bbox.difference(street buffer).difference(already-tracked polygons) around the Mission Hall/Byers Hall area, anchored on the real 4th St x 16th St and 3rd St x 16th St street-corner intersections per the owner's direct instruction (earlier attempts using building bounding boxes had repeatedly mis-centered on the wrong block). Fragment 14 (7,505 sqm raw) spans the whole plan block from Mission Hall's own footprint east toward 3rd St; the owner identified it as 25A+25B combined, with Mission Hall itself being 25A and this record -- the part east of Mission Hall, idealized as a clean rectangle -- being 25B.

record.notes: OCII plan block 25B. Surface parking lot immediately east of Mission Hall (Global Health & Clinical Sciences Building), between it and 3rd St, north of 16th St. Currently undeveloped/planned per the OCII plan designation.
